name: vertical-thumbnail-slider
title: Vertical Thumbnail Slider
description: A photo gallery where a tall column of small previews sits to the left of one large image. Clicking or dragging through the column moves the main photo, which scrolls vertically instead of sideways.
use: A handful of images must share a compact block and still show one large preview at a time.
avoid: The demo caps the frame at 400px tall and hardcodes seven photo URLs inside the file.
a11y: Every image is labelled simply 'image', and there is no visible focus treatment or reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide photo fills most of a black stage. Down the left edge runs a thin column of seven small landscape thumbnails with rounded corners, separated by narrow gaps. The active thumbnail sits inside a light rounded outline that marks it out from the rest.
behaves: The thumbnail column and the large frame move together on a vertical axis: dragging the strip or the photo scrolls to the next image, and the outgoing picture slides away top or bottom. The outline hops to whichever thumbnail is current.
customise: Photo URLs, order and count live in the component file; width and height are set by classes on the shared carousel wrappers, not by props.
weight: light: Seven images in one drag carousel; nothing runs while the page is idle.
demo: Seven Unsplash nature photos: a dark lake shore, a misty lake with bare trees, and a pink flower on a pale background.
issues: Every photo in the source has the alt text 'image', so none is described.
polishWhy: Tidy dark gallery with a clear active thumbnail; only the cramped thumbnails and 400px cap date it.
